app.name: CovertCook
app.tagline: One dinner, one secret recipe, one chain.

auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, an email has been sent.
auth.staleSession: This session belongs to an account that no longer exists. Sign out and create the account again.

dietary.title: Your dietary restrictions
dietary.help: What you can't eat — never a diagnosis, just what's needed to cook for you.
dietary.label: What
dietary.required: Tick "no restrictions" or add at least one entry.
dietary.panelEmpty: Nobody has flagged a restriction for this dinner.

rounds.name: Round name

setup.classicHint: covered dinner, one recipe each, voting on. Nothing to decide.
setup.customHint: choose who gets in, who knows whom, and how you vote.

access.label: How people get in
access.CODEHint: You get a code to share however you like. Anyone holding it can ask for a seat.
access.INVITEHint: You add chefs by the address they signed up with. They accept or decline in the app — no code to mistype or forward.

anonymity.label: Who knows whom
anonymity.ANONYMOUSHint: Everyone is a pseudonym until the final reveal, you included.
anonymity.SPY: Spy — you see everyone, they see nobody
anonymity.SPYHint: You keep each chef's real name beside their pseudonym. Everyone else sees pseudonyms only. You'll still have to ask before you can see who cooks for whom.
anonymity.OPENHint: Real names stay visible all evening. Only who cooks for whom stays secret.

rounds.requiresApproval: The Executive Chef must approve each player

voting.label: Voting
voting.LIVEHint: You open the vote at the table and see the results first, then decide how to announce them.
voting.TIMEDHint: You set a deadline and the results publish themselves when it runs out.
voting.DISABLEDHint: This one can't be undone: voting will be unavailable for this dinner, and can't be turned on later.

rounds.removeConfirm: Remove this player from the round?
rounds.removeDishConfirm: Both the incoming and outgoing dish are already submitted; removing this member discards one of them. Continue?
rounds.removeCollapseConfirm: Reconnect the chain around this player. Whoever was writing for them will write for the next cook instead, so everyone still has a dish to make — but that cook gets a different recipe than the one they already have.
rounds.removeLeaveConfirm: Leave the chain exactly as it is. Nobody else is disturbed, and the dish written for this player simply won't be cooked.
rounds.secretName: Your secret name for this round
rounds.youHost: You are the Executive Chef of this dinner
rounds.rosterCovered: Names stay covered until sign-ups close, so nobody can tell who is who from the order people arrived in.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.rerollConfirm: This replaces everyone's current pairing with a new random one. Continue?
assignment.ready: Assignment generated — ready to move to "Assigned".
assignment.needed: Generate the assignment below before you can move to "Assigned".
assignment.waitingForHost: Waiting for the Executive Chef to spin the roulette.
assignment.explain: Everyone is signed up and the table is locked. Spin the roulette to pair each chef with the one they will cook for.

settings.title: Round settings
settings.detailsLockedNote: Diner info can no longer be edited once the dinner has started.
settings.noStepBack: This round is at its earliest phase.
settings.cancelConfirm: This cancels the round for everyone. This cannot be undone. Continue?
settings.exclusionsHelp: Pick two players who must not be paired together (e.g. a couple who'd rather not cook for each other).
settings.coursesHelp: This round uses specific courses — the number of slots below must equal the number of active players ({{count}}) before you can generate the assignment.
settings.notesPlaceholder: Door code, what to bring, where to park.

stepBackWhat.DRAFT: The join code stops working, so nobody new can ask for a seat. Everyone already at the table stays.
stepBackWhat.OPEN: The door reopens: anyone holding the code can ask for a seat again.
stepBackWhat.LOCKED: The pairings stay exactly as they are — they are not thrown away. Chefs simply cannot write their recipe again until you move forward.
stepBackWhat.ASSIGNED: Recipes become editable again, and the cooks stop seeing the one they received until you move forward. Anything already submitted stays submitted.
stepBackWhat.BRIEFS_CLOSED: The dinner stops being marked as happening. The recipes stay readable to the chefs cooking them.
stepBackWhat.DINNER: Voting closes. Ballots already cast are kept, and voting picks up where it left off if you move forward again.
stepBackWhat.VOTING: The results go back to provisional and are recalculated when you move forward. Every ballot is kept.

settings.stepBackNothingLost: Nothing is deleted by stepping back — only what people are allowed to do right now changes.

invitations.title: Invitations ({{count}})
invitations.noSuchChef: No chef signed up with that address. Check the spelling, or share the code instead.

rounds.tooManyPlayers: Thirty is already a lot of cooking. Where were you planning to seat them all — is this a wedding?
rounds.tooFewPlayers: It takes at least three: with two, you would both know exactly who wrote your recipe.

waiting.assignment: Opens once the Executive Chef spins the roulette
waiting.briefs: Opens once the recipes are in
waiting.vote: Opens when the Executive Chef starts the vote

rounds.confirmJoin: You were invited to a dinner with this code. Join it?
rounds.lateJoinerWarning: Sign-ups are closed and the chain is set. You can still add someone — the chain is opened at one point to fit them in — but everyone around that point gets a different partner than the one they had.
rounds.pendingJoinBanner: Your invitation is being held — dinner code

joinErrors.INVALID_CODE: No dinner uses that code. Check the spelling.
joinErrors.ROUND_NOT_OPEN: That dinner is not taking new chefs right now.
joinErrors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already at this table.
joinErrors.AWAITING_APPROVAL: You have already asked to join. The Executive Chef has not answered yet — you will see the dinner here as soon as they do.
joinErrors.PREVIOUSLY_LEFT: You left this dinner. Ask the Executive Chef to add you back.
joinErrors.WAS_REMOVED: The Executive Chef removed you from this dinner.

chainChoice.intro: The chain is already built. Taking a link out leaves two loose ends — decide what happens to them.
chainChoice.collapse: The two ends are joined. B writes for D instead, so everyone still has a dish to make — but D is handed a different recipe than the one they already have.
chainChoice.leave: The ends stay loose. Nobody else is disturbed, and the dish written for the departing chef simply is not cooked.

menu.title: Compose the menu
menu.freeHint: everyone brings whatever they like. Nothing to plan.
menu.composedHint: you decide the courses, and each chef is given one to write.
menu.balanced: {{courses}} courses for {{seats}} chefs — the menu is complete.
menu.unbalanced: {{courses}} courses for {{seats}} chefs. Every chef cooks exactly one dish, so these two have to match before the roulette can run.
menu.locked: The menu can no longer change: the chefs are already writing for the courses they were given.

errors.MENU_LOCKED: The menu is set — the chefs already have their courses. Re-roll the roulette to change it.
errors.COURSE_IN_USE: Somebody is already cooking that course.

rounds.lateJoinerShort: Adding someone now changes two chefs' partners.

briefs.alreadySubmitted: Your brief is submitted and locked.
briefs.editingClosed: The submission window for this round has closed.
briefs.tagsConfirmed: I've reviewed the dietary panel above and confirmed the tags I've checked are accurate.
briefs.cannotCook: I can't cook this after all
briefs.cannotCookSent: Sent — the Executive Chef has been notified.
briefs.acknowledged: You confirmed you can cook this.
briefs.ingredientsPlaceholder: One per line — 200 g flour, 3 eggs, a pinch of salt.
briefs.procedurePlaceholder: How to make it. However you like.
briefs.freeChoice: Free choice — any dish you like.
briefs.labelDish: Put a card next to this dish
briefs.labelDishWhy: It contains {{items}}, and somebody at this table has said that matters to them. A card by the dish is what lets them decide for themselves.
briefs.needsMore: A name, and either a link or the recipe written out.

errors.DISH_NAME_LENGTH: The dish needs a name of at least three characters.
errors.RECIPE_TOO_EMPTY: Add a link, or write out the recipe.

chat.title: Messages
chat.slotValueRequired: This message needs a value filled in.

vote.title: Vote the menu
vote.instructions: Drag to rank every dish, best first. Optional: rate originality and how closely the brief was followed.
vote.thanks: Thanks — your ballot has been recorded.
vote.hostOnly: You are the only one who can see these. Announce them when you are ready.
vote.waitingPublish: The Executive Chef has the results and has not announced them yet.

chain.title: Chain
chain.spoilerWarning: This reveals every pairing in the round. Only open this once you're ready to know.
chain.multipleCycles: This assignment has split into {{count}} separate loops (a manual swap can do this) — everyone is still assigned exactly once.
chain.spliceTitle: Add a late joiner into the chain
